- name: quickbooks__customer_analytics
      description: Customer analytics with revenue trends, behavior patterns, RFM-style scoring, growth percentages, and risk assessments (one row per customer_id, source_relation)
      grain: One row per customer_id and source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis
      business_logic: '- Start with customer_base as all columns from intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle, one row per (customer_id, source_relation). - Build revenue_details from intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis by month per (customer_id, source_relation): • monthly_customer_revenue = sum of total_amount • monthly_customer_invoices = distinct invoice count • monthly_avg_invoice_amount = average total_amount • monthly_collected_amount = sum of collected_amount • monthly_outstanding_balance = sum of outstanding_balance - Compute customer_revenue_trends by aggregating revenue_details per (customer_id, source_relation): • Define windows relative to current_date: - Last 3 months: months starting on or after 3 months ago - Previous 3 months: the 3 months immediately before the last 3 months - Current quarter: months on or after the start of the current quarter - Previous quarter: the 3 months immediately before the current quarter - Current year: months on or after the start of the current year - Previous year: months in the year immediately before the current year • For each window, sum monthly_customer_revenue; sums return 0 when a customer has revenue months outside the window but none inside; customers with no revenue rows have NULLs after the LEFT JOIN. • Activity and stability: - active_months = distinct count of revenue months across all time - active_months_last_12 = distinct count of revenue months within the last 12 months - last_revenue_month = most recent revenue month - revenue_volatility = sample standard deviation of monthly_customer_revenue - avg_monthly_revenue = average of monthly_customer_revenue - revenue_trend_correlation = Pearson correlation between month time and monthly_customer_revenue - Compute customer_behavior_patterns from customer_base: • Pass through base metrics (e.g., total_invoices, avg_invoice_amount, monthly_revenue_avg, customer_lifespan_days, payment_rate_percentage, total_payment_amount, unique_products_purchased, total_quantity_purchased). • acquisition_season by month of first_invoice_date: Winter (Dec/Jan/Feb), Spring (Mar–May), Summer (Jun–Aug), else Fall; defaults to Fall when first_invoice_date is NULL. • annual_transaction_frequency = round(total_invoices*365.0/customer_lifespan_days, 2) when lifespan>0 and invoices>0; else 0. • customer_maturity_stage by customer_lifespan_days: ≥1095 Mature (3+ years); ≥730 Established (2+ years); ≥365 Developing (1+ year); ≥90 Growing (3+ months); else New (< 3 months). - Build customer_segmentation by LEFT JOINing customer_base to customer_revenue_trends and customer_behavior_patterns on (customer_id, source_relation), then compute: • recency_score by days_since_last_invoice: ≤30→5, ≤60→4, ≤90→3, ≤180→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • frequency_score by annual_transaction_frequency: ≥12→5, ≥6→4, ≥3→3, ≥1→2, else 1. • monetary_score by total_invoice_amount: ≥50000→5, ≥20000→4, ≥5000→3, ≥1000→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • growth_score: if revenue_prev_3_months>0 then by growth ratio (last_3 vs prev_3: >50%→5, >20%→4, >0→3, >-20%→2, else 1); else 3. • payment_score by payment_rate_percentage: ≥95→5, ≥85→4, ≥70→3, ≥50→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). - Final output: • Growth percentages (3m, QoQ, YoY) are computed only when the respective previous period > 0; value = round(((current - previous)/previous)*100, 2); else NULL. • overall_customer_score = round(average of the five scores, 1). • rfm_segment via ordered rules on R/F/M; default ''Lost''. • recommended_action via ordered rules on R/F/M; default ''Monitor and maintain''. • risk_assessment priority: - High Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>180 and total_invoice_amount>10000 - else Medium Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>90 and three-month growth%< -50 (growth%=0 when revenue_prev_3_months≤0) - else Payment Risk if payment_rate_percentage<70 - else Volatility Risk if revenue_volatility>avg_monthly_revenue - else Low Risk • Filter out rows where customer_id is NULL and order by total_invoice_amount descending, then overall_customer_score descending.'

specification.grain: One row per customer_id and source_relation
specification.business_logic: - Start with customer_base as all columns from intermediate.int_quickbooks__customer_lifecycle, one row per (customer_id, source_relation). - Build revenue_details from intermediate.int_quickbooks__revenue_analysis by month per (customer_id, source_relation): • monthly_customer_revenue = sum of total_amount • monthly_customer_invoices = distinct invoice count • monthly_avg_invoice_amount = average total_amount • monthly_collected_amount = sum of collected_amount • monthly_outstanding_balance = sum of outstanding_balance - Compute customer_revenue_trends by aggregating revenue_details per (customer_id, source_relation): • Define windows relative to current_date: - Last 3 months: months starting on or after 3 months ago - Previous 3 months: the 3 months immediately before the last 3 months - Current quarter: months on or after the start of the current quarter - Previous quarter: the 3 months immediately before the current quarter - Current year: months on or after the start of the current year - Previous year: months in the year immediately before the current year • For each window, sum monthly_customer_revenue; sums return 0 when a customer has revenue months outside the window but none inside; customers with no revenue rows have NULLs after the LEFT JOIN. • Activity and stability: - active_months = distinct count of revenue months across all time - active_months_last_12 = distinct count of revenue months within the last 12 months - last_revenue_month = most recent revenue month - revenue_volatility = sample standard deviation of monthly_customer_revenue - avg_monthly_revenue = average of monthly_customer_revenue - revenue_trend_correlation = Pearson correlation between month time and monthly_customer_revenue - Compute customer_behavior_patterns from customer_base: • Pass through base metrics (e.g., total_invoices, avg_invoice_amount, monthly_revenue_avg, customer_lifespan_days, payment_rate_percentage, total_payment_amount, unique_products_purchased, total_quantity_purchased). • acquisition_season by month of first_invoice_date: Winter (Dec/Jan/Feb), Spring (Mar–May), Summer (Jun–Aug), else Fall; defaults to Fall when first_invoice_date is NULL. • annual_transaction_frequency = round(total_invoices*365.0/customer_lifespan_days, 2) when lifespan>0 and invoices>0; else 0. • customer_maturity_stage by customer_lifespan_days: ≥1095 Mature (3+ years); ≥730 Established (2+ years); ≥365 Developing (1+ year); ≥90 Growing (3+ months); else New (< 3 months). - Build customer_segmentation by LEFT JOINing customer_base to customer_revenue_trends and customer_behavior_patterns on (customer_id, source_relation), then compute: • recency_score by days_since_last_invoice: ≤30→5, ≤60→4, ≤90→3, ≤180→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • frequency_score by annual_transaction_frequency: ≥12→5, ≥6→4, ≥3→3, ≥1→2, else 1. • monetary_score by total_invoice_amount: ≥50000→5, ≥20000→4, ≥5000→3, ≥1000→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). • growth_score: if revenue_prev_3_months>0 then by growth ratio (last_3 vs prev_3: >50%→5, >20%→4, >0→3, >-20%→2, else 1); else 3. • payment_score by payment_rate_percentage: ≥95→5, ≥85→4, ≥70→3, ≥50→2, else 1 (NULL treated as else). - Final output: • Growth percentages (3m, QoQ, YoY) are computed only when the respective previous period > 0; value = round(((current - previous)/previous)*100, 2); else NULL. • overall_customer_score = round(average of the five scores, 1). • rfm_segment via ordered rules on R/F/M; default 'Lost'. • recommended_action via ordered rules on R/F/M; default 'Monitor and maintain'. • risk_assessment priority: - High Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>180 and total_invoice_amount>10000 - else Medium Churn Risk if days_since_last_invoice>90 and three-month growth%< -50 (growth%=0 when revenue_prev_3_months≤0) - else Payment Risk if payment_rate_percentage<70 - else Volatility Risk if revenue_volatility>avg_monthly_revenue - else Low Risk • Filter out rows where customer_id is NULL and order by total_invoice_amount descending, then overall_customer_score descending.

WITH entries AS (
 SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry
), enriched AS (
 SELECT e.*,a.account_number,a.name account_name,a.is_sub_account,a.parent_account_number,a.parent_account_name,a.account_type account_type,a.account_sub_type,a.financial_statement_helper,a.balance account_current_balance,a.classification account_class,a.transaction_type account_transaction_type,
 md5(concat_ws('|',coalesce(e.transaction_id,''),coalesce(e.source_relation,''),coalesce(cast(e.index as varchar),''),coalesce(e.account_id,''),coalesce(e.transaction_type,''),coalesce(e.transaction_source,''))) unique_id,
 CASE WHEN a.transaction_type=e.transaction_type THEN e.amount ELSE e.amount*-1 END adjusted_amount,
 CASE WHEN a.transaction_type=e.transaction_type THEN e.converted_amount ELSE e.converted_amount*-1 END adjusted_converted_amount
 FROM entries e LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications a ON e.account_id=a.account_id AND e.source_relation=a.source_relation
), running AS (
 SELECT *,sum(adjusted_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id,class_id,source_relation ORDER BY source_relation,transaction_date,account_id,class_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)::DECIMAL(38,6) running_balance,
 sum(adjusted_converted_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY account_id,class_id,source_relation ORDER BY source_relation,transaction_date,account_id,class_id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)::DECIMAL(38,12) running_converted_balance FROM enriched
)

- name: quickbooks__general_ledger
      description: Unified general ledger combining bill, journal entry, and payment double-entry records enriched with account attributes, signed amounts, and running balances
      grain: One row per unique_id (double-entry line item)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry
      - intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications
      business_logic: '- Union all rows from intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry, intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry, and intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry; duplicates are preserved. - From the union, select: transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_date, customer_id, vendor_id, amount, converted_amount, account_id, class_id, department_id, transaction_type, transaction_source, created_at, updated_at. - Left join intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications on (account_id, source_relation) to enrich account fields; if no match, account_* fields are NULL. - Compute unique_id by building a pipe-delimited string from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that exact order; treat NULL components as empty strings; hash this string with MD5 to produce a lowercase hex identifier. - Compute adjusted_amount: if account_transaction_type equals transaction_type, use amount; otherwise use amount multiplied by -1; if amount is NULL, adjusted_amount is NULL; when either type is NULL, treat as a mismatch and negate. - Compute adjusted_converted_amount the same way using converted_amount from the union (converted_amount itself is not included in the final output); NULLs propagate. - Compute running_balance as a cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition, ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id with rows unbounded preceding. - Compute running_converted_balance similarly using adjusted_converted_amount with the same partitioning and ordering. - Window ties on all ordering keys are engine-defined; cumulative sums skip NULL values and return NULL only when the entire frame is NULL. - Output one row per double-entry line enriched with account fields, signed amounts, and running balances.'
      columns:
      - name: unique_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lowercase MD5 of the pipe-delimited string built from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that order; NULL inputs are treated as empty strings.
      - name: transaction_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source transaction identifier from the unioned double-entry models; preserved as-is.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Originating model for the entry (bill, journal_entry, payment); used in the account join and in window partitioning and ordering.
      - name: transaction_index
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Line index within the source transaction (from 'index'); preserved as-is.
      - name: transaction_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Transaction posting date from source; used in window ordering.
      - name: customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.
      - name: vendor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Vendor identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.
      - name: amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Raw amount from source used to compute adjusted_amount; may be NULL.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from source; used to join classifications and to partition running balances.
      - name: class_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Class identifier from source; used to partition running balances; may be NULL.
      - name: department_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department identifier from source; preserved as-is; may be NULL.
      - name: account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account number from classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account name from classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: is_sub_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if the account is a sub-account per classifications; NULL if no account match.
      - name: parent_account_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account number from classifications; NULL if none or no match.
      - name: parent_account_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent account name from classifications; NULL if none or no match.
      - name: account_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High-level account type from classifications (e.g., Asset, Liability); NULL if no match.
      - name: account_sub_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-type within the account_type from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: financial_statement_helper
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Helper label from classifications indicating financial statement grouping; NULL if no match.
      - name: account_current_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(28,6)
        description: Current account balance from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: account_class
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Classification label from classifications; NULL if no match.
      - name: transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Entry type from source (e.g., Debit/Credit or analogous); determines adjusted_amount sign.
      - name: transaction_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source subtype label from the unioned models; included in unique_id but not used in window partitioning.
      - name: account_transaction_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account-side transaction type from classifications; compared to transaction_type to set amount sign; may be NULL.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Row creation timestamp from source; preserved as-is.
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Row update timestamp from source; preserved as-is.
      - name: adjusted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: 'Signed amount: equals amount when account_transaction_type equals transaction_type; otherwise amount multiplied by -1; NULL if amount is NULL.'
      - name: adjusted_converted_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: 'Signed converted amount derived from source converted_amount: equals converted_amount when types match, otherwise negated; NULL if converted_amount is NULL.'
      - name: running_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,6)
        description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.
      - name: running_converted_balance
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,12)
        description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_converted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.

specification.grain: One row per unique_id (double-entry line item)
specification.business_logic: - Union all rows from intermediate.int_quickbooks__bill_double_entry, intermediate.int_quickbooks__journal_entry_double_entry, and intermediate.int_quickbooks__payment_double_entry; duplicates are preserved. - From the union, select: transaction_id, source_relation, index, transaction_date, customer_id, vendor_id, amount, converted_amount, account_id, class_id, department_id, transaction_type, transaction_source, created_at, updated_at. - Left join intermediate.int_quickbooks__account_classifications on (account_id, source_relation) to enrich account fields; if no match, account_* fields are NULL. - Compute unique_id by building a pipe-delimited string from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that exact order; treat NULL components as empty strings; hash this string with MD5 to produce a lowercase hex identifier. - Compute adjusted_amount: if account_transaction_type equals transaction_type, use amount; otherwise use amount multiplied by -1; if amount is NULL, adjusted_amount is NULL; when either type is NULL, treat as a mismatch and negate. - Compute adjusted_converted_amount the same way using converted_amount from the union (converted_amount itself is not included in the final output); NULLs propagate. - Compute running_balance as a cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition, ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id with rows unbounded preceding. - Compute running_converted_balance similarly using adjusted_converted_amount with the same partitioning and ordering. - Window ties on all ordering keys are engine-defined; cumulative sums skip NULL values and return NULL only when the entire frame is NULL. - Output one row per double-entry line enriched with account fields, signed amounts, and running balances.

columns.name: unique_id
columns.description: Lowercase MD5 of the pipe-delimited string built from transaction_id, source_relation, index, account_id, transaction_type, transaction_source in that order; NULL inputs are treated as empty strings.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.description: Source transaction identifier from the unioned double-entry models; preserved as-is.

columns.name: source_relation
columns.description: Originating model for the entry (bill, journal_entry, payment); used in the account join and in window partitioning and ordering.

columns.name: transaction_index
columns.description: Line index within the source transaction (from 'index'); preserved as-is.

columns.name: transaction_date
columns.description: Transaction posting date from source; used in window ordering.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.

columns.name: vendor_id
columns.description: Vendor identifier associated with the transaction when applicable; may be NULL.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Raw amount from source used to compute adjusted_amount; may be NULL.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: Account identifier from source; used to join classifications and to partition running balances.

columns.name: class_id
columns.description: Class identifier from source; used to partition running balances; may be NULL.

columns.name: department_id
columns.description: Department identifier from source; preserved as-is; may be NULL.

columns.name: account_number
columns.description: Account number from classifications; NULL if no account match.

columns.name: account_name
columns.description: Account name from classifications; NULL if no account match.

columns.name: is_sub_account
columns.description: TRUE if the account is a sub-account per classifications; NULL if no account match.

columns.name: parent_account_number
columns.description: Parent account number from classifications; NULL if none or no match.

columns.name: parent_account_name
columns.description: Parent account name from classifications; NULL if none or no match.

columns.name: account_type
columns.description: High-level account type from classifications (e.g., Asset, Liability); NULL if no match.

columns.name: account_sub_type
columns.description: Sub-type within the account_type from classifications; NULL if no match.

columns.name: financial_statement_helper
columns.description: Helper label from classifications indicating financial statement grouping; NULL if no match.

columns.name: account_current_balance
columns.description: Current account balance from classifications; NULL if no match.

columns.name: account_class
columns.description: Classification label from classifications; NULL if no match.

columns.name: transaction_type
columns.description: Entry type from source (e.g., Debit/Credit or analogous); determines adjusted_amount sign.

columns.name: transaction_source
columns.description: Source subtype label from the unioned models; included in unique_id but not used in window partitioning.

columns.name: account_transaction_type
columns.description: Account-side transaction type from classifications; compared to transaction_type to set amount sign; may be NULL.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Row creation timestamp from source; preserved as-is.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Row update timestamp from source; preserved as-is.

columns.name: adjusted_amount
columns.description: Signed amount: equals amount when account_transaction_type equals transaction_type; otherwise amount multiplied by -1; NULL if amount is NULL.

columns.name: adjusted_converted_amount
columns.description: Signed converted amount derived from source converted_amount: equals converted_amount when types match, otherwise negated; NULL if converted_amount is NULL.

columns.name: running_balance
columns.description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.

columns.name: running_converted_balance
columns.description: Cumulative sum of adjusted_converted_amount within each (account_id, class_id, source_relation) partition ordered by source_relation, transaction_date, account_id, class_id; NULLs are skipped.

columns.description: Number of days from today to last_transaction_date; NULL if last_transaction_date is NULL.

columns.name: spend_current_quarter
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for months on/after the current quarter start; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.

columns.name: spend_prev_quarter
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for the prior quarter window; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.

columns.name: spend_current_year
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for months on/after the current year start; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.

columns.name: spend_prev_year
columns.description: Sum of total_amount for the previous calendar year window; outside months add zero; NULL if all qualifying amounts are NULL; 0 if none qualify.

columns.name: spend_volatility
columns.description: Sample standard deviation of total_amount across bills; NULL if fewer than two non-NULL amounts.

columns.name: payment_completion_rate
columns.description: Fully paid bills as a percentage of all rows for the vendor and source; not rounded.

columns.name: on_time_payment_rate
columns.description: On-time/early payments as a percentage of rows excluding 'Incomplete Payment'; NULL when that denominator is zero; not rounded.

columns.name: total_outstanding
columns.description: Sum of outstanding_balance across vendor rows; NULLs ignored; NULL if all are NULL.

columns.name: primary_purchase_category
columns.description: Highest-spend purchase_category per vendor and source; ties resolved arbitrarily; NULL if none.

columns.name: primary_category_spend
columns.description: Total spend in the primary_purchase_category; NULL if no category.

columns.name: category_diversity
columns.description: Distinct count of non-NULL purchase_category values per vendor and source.

columns.name: vendor_tier
columns.description: Vendor tier from source (e.g., Strategic Vendor, Major Vendor); used in risk and strategy rules.

columns.name: payment_risk_level
columns.description: Payment risk level from source; carried for context.

columns.name: payment_reliability_score
columns.description: Score (25/20/15/10/5) by payment_completion_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65; defaults to 5 when rate is NULL.

columns.name: timeliness_score
columns.description: Score (25/20/15/10/5) by on_time_payment_rate thresholds: ≥95, ≥85, ≥75, ≥65; defaults to 5 when rate is NULL.

columns.name: relationship_stability_score
columns.description: Score (25/20/15/10/5) by days_since_last_transaction thresholds: ≤30, ≤60, ≤90, ≤180; defaults to 5 when NULL.

columns.name: business_value_score
columns.description: Score (25/20/15/10/5) by total_lifetime_spend thresholds: ≥50,000; ≥20,000; ≥5,000; ≥1,000; defaults to 5 when NULL.

columns.name: overall_performance_score
columns.description: Sum of payment_reliability, timeliness, relationship_stability, and business_value scores.

columns.name: quarterly_spend_growth_pct
columns.description: Percent change from prior to current quarter, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-quarter spend is not positive.

columns.name: annual_spend_growth_pct
columns.description: Percent change from prior to current year, rounded to two decimals; NULL when prior-year spend is not positive.

columns.name: transaction_value_profile
columns.description: Classification by average transaction size: >1,000 High Value Transactions; >500 Medium; otherwise Low; defaults to Low when undefined.

columns.name: performance_rating
columns.description: Rating by overall_performance_score: ≥85 Excellent; ≥70 Good; ≥55 Fair; ≥40 Poor; otherwise Critical.

columns.name: risk_assessment
columns.description: Priority rules: >30% outstanding High Financial Risk; >180 days with strategic/major tier High Relationship Risk; on-time <70 High Payment Risk; volatility >2× average High Volatility Risk; >15% outstanding Medium Financial Risk; >90 days Medium Relationship Risk; otherwise Low Risk.

columns.name: recommended_strategy
columns.description: Priority rules: high overall with strategic/major Strengthen Partnership; overall ≥70 with recent activity Maintain Relationship; low payment rates Improve Payment Terms; inactivity >180 Re-engage or Replace; >20% outstanding Address Outstanding Issues; overall <55 Performance Review Required; otherwise Monitor Performance.

columns.name: avg_monthly_spend
columns.description: Total lifetime spend divided by active months, rounded to two decimals; NULL when active_months is zero.

columns.name: avg_transaction_size
columns.description: Total lifetime spend divided by total_transactions, rounded to two decimals; NULL when total_transactions is zero.

columns.name: dependency_level
columns.description: Based on primary_category_spend: ≥50,000 High; ≥20,000 Medium; ≥5,000 Low; otherwise Minimal; NULL treated as Minimal.
